brief:
Israeli occupation forces conducted raids on homes and deployed in significant numbers throughout the northern neighborhood of Tulkarm city, Shehab Wire reported. The operation saw troops spread across multiple locations in the area as part of what appeared to be a coordinated security sweep.

The nature and stated objective of the incursion remained unclear from available reports. No immediate information was available regarding potential casualties, arrests, or the specific targets of the raids carried out by the forces during the operation.
